name: MerchantReservationEnquiry
description: MerchantReservationEnquiry schema from Quandoo Public Partner API

id.description: The unique identifier of the reservation enquiry for the calling agent (Agent dependent field) or NULL if the agent identifier should be created. Optional.

merchantId.description: The ID of the merchant at which this reservation will be made.

capacity.description: The capacity (people count) of the reservation enquiry.

startDateTime.description: The start date and time of the potential reservation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

endDateTime.description: The end date and time of the potential reservation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
